{
  "name": "@startuphafen/deploy3",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "Refactored deployment and data copy tools",
  "private": true,
  "type": "module",
  "scripts": {
    "deploy": "tsx bin/deploy.ts",
    "copy": "tsx bin/copy.ts",
    "prep-copy": "tsx bin/prep-copy.ts",
    "test": "node --experimental-vm-modules ../../node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@types/jest": "^29.5.14",
    "ts-jest": "^29.2.5",
    "tsx": "^4.21.0",
    "typescript": "^5.9.3"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "zod": "^3.23.8"
  }
}
